actName: The Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970
description: The Contract Labour Act regulates the employment of contract workers and ensures contractors and establishments comply with labour welfare, wage, working condition and registration requirements. It mandates proper licensing, worker records, wage payments and welfare facilities wherever applicable.

actName: The Shops and Commercial Establishments Act & Rules
description: The Shops and Commercial Establishments Act regulates working conditions in shops, offices and commercial establishments, covering working hours, weekly holidays, leave, wages and employee welfare. It requires establishments to maintain prescribed records, registers and comply with state-specific registration and labour regulations.

The Maternity Benefit Act ensures maternity-related benefits for eligible women employees, including paid maternity leave, protection from dismissal during maternity, and other prescribed benefits. It regulates employer obligations regarding maternity leave, nursing breaks and related welfare provisions.

The Minimum Wages Act ensures that employees receive wages at or above the minimum rates prescribed by the government for their respective occupations and industries. It governs wage rates, payment compliance, and maintenance of prescribed records to protect workers from underpayment.

actName: The Labour Welfare Fund Act & Rules
description: The Labour Welfare Fund Act aims to promote the welfare of employees by providing financial support and welfare-related benefits through contributions from employers, employees and, where applicable, the government. It covers welfare initiatives, fund contributions, and prescribed compliance records.

actName: The Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 & Rules
description: The Payment of Bonus Act regulates the payment of bonuses to eligible employees based on statutory provisions and the organisation's allocable surplus. It establishes eligibility, minimum and maximum bonus limits, calculation rules and employer obligations for maintaining prescribed records.

actName: The Employment Exchanges (Compulsory Notification of Vacancies) Act, 1959
description: The Employment Exchanges Act requires employers to notify designated employment exchanges about specified vacancies to promote employment opportunities and support workforce placement. It outlines vacancy reporting requirements, prescribed procedures and record-keeping obligations for covered establishments.

actName: The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 & Rules
description: The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act prohibits the employment of children in prohibited occupations and activities and regulates the working conditions of adolescents where permitted. It aims to protect children from exploitation and ensure compliance with age-related employment restrictions and statutory requirements.

actName: The Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
description: The POSH Act aims to prevent, prohibit and redress sexual harassment of women in the workplace by ensuring a safe and respectful working environment. It requires covered workplaces to establish an Internal Committee, handle complaints appropriately and comply with prescribed awareness and reporting obligations.

The Equal Remuneration Act aims to ensure equal pay for men and women performing the same work or work of similar nature and prevent gender-based discrimination in employment. It regulates wage equality and promotes fair treatment in recruitment and employment conditions.

actName: The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 & Rules
description: The Payment of Wages Act regulates the timely payment of wages to employees and ensures that employers follow prescribed wage payment schedules. It covers authorised deductions, wage periods, payment deadlines and maintenance of required wage records.

The Employees’ Compensation Act provides financial compensation to employees or their dependants in cases of employment-related injuries, disabilities or death arising out of and in the course of employment. It defines employer liability, compensation calculation and procedures for reporting and settling eligible claims.

actName: The National and Festival Holidays Act & Rules
description: The National and Festival Holidays Act regulates holidays for employees on specified national and festival occasions. It requires employers to provide prescribed holidays, ensure applicable wages or compensatory benefits for work performed on such days, and maintain relevant holiday records.

actName: The Maharashtra Workmen Minimum House Rent Allowance Act, 1990 & Rules
description: The Maharashtra Workmen Minimum House Rent Allowance Act regulates the payment of house rent allowance to eligible workmen in covered establishments in Maharashtra. It defines employer obligations regarding HRA payments, applicable rates and compliance with prescribed statutory requirements.

The Factories Act regulates the health, safety, welfare and working conditions of workers employed in factories. It lays down requirements for workplace hygiene, ventilation, machinery safety, working hours, welfare facilities and accident prevention to ensure a safe working environment.

actName: The Employees Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 & Schemes (EPF & EDLI)
description: The Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act provides social security benefits to eligible employees through provident fund, pension and deposit-linked insurance schemes. It governs employer and employee contributions, statutory deductions, fund administration and maintenance of prescribed records.

actName: The Employees State Insurance Act, 1948 & Regulations
description: The Employees’ State Insurance Act provides social security and healthcare benefits to eligible employees and their dependants. It covers medical care, sickness, maternity, disablement and dependants’ benefits, supported by statutory employer and employee contributions and prescribed compliance records.

actName: The Professional Tax (State Enactments) Act & Rules
description: The Professional Tax Act regulates the levy, deduction and payment of professional tax by employers and eligible employees as prescribed under applicable state laws. It covers employer registration, employee-wise tax deductions, timely remittance to the state authorities and maintenance of statutory records.

actName: The Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 & Rules (PSARA / PSRGA)
description: The Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005 regulates the operations of private security agencies and ensures that they operate with valid licences and meet prescribed requirements. It covers agency licensing, eligibility and verification of security personnel, training standards and maintenance of statutory records.
